svg.title: Downtown Fairbanks, summer 1967: walkable map
svg.text: flows west (to the left), toward the Tanana
play area: x -195 to 55, z -60 to 140 (250 x 200 m)
Meters. Origin (0, 0) at the south end
of the Cushman Street bridge; x east,
night: Silver Pan to boarding house
August: the skiff at Owen's door
red, white and blue mail box
One flat water surface; depth over grade per
band, from the downtown high-water marks:
about 5 ft near the river, 2 ft at the Co-op
on 2nd Ave, 15 in at the old post office,
Order and neighbors are kept; distances are not.
River straightened to run east-west. Blocks
about half their real depth; Cushman from 3rd
to 5th squeezed hardest. Street order west of
Cushman (Lacey, then Noble) is to be checked.
about 2.5 km southwest, Airport Way and Peger.
Phillips Field bush strip: north side of the
Polaris (11 floors) at First and Lacey; the
Northward (8) south of Third; the N.C.'s two
stacks east; the church steeple and St.
Joseph's across the river; low hills north.
Names of bars, the boarding house, the land
office, the float shed and the dock are ours.
